concerns.text: The diff commits raw run-time logs (backend.log, frontend/frontend.log) directly into the repository, which is not recommended.

The PDF generation logic uses hardcoded absolute paths for fonts (e.g. /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf), which can cause export failures on environments where these font packages are missing.

The authentication mechanism (/auth/login) parses authorization tokens simply via splitting 'username:role' without cryptographically signing or validating the identity, leading to possible privilege escalation if exposed.

verdicts.criticalReason: Committed forbidden generated artifacts under the .eneik/ directory: desktop-1440.png and mobile-375.png. Modifying or committing files under the .eneik/ directory is strictly forbidden for standard feature development and will trigger immediate automated gate failures.

concerns.text: The sendActualizationRequest and postComment frontend functions fake success by setting local success state/comments even when the API request returns a non-2xx failure status or throws a network error.
The loadComments function sends an Authorization Bearer header using only the username instead of a complete token, which fails compatibility with standard auth validation requirements.
